description: Your word on a Fog case. "flag_others": the flag moves from the odd one to the Fogs of the majority (a coordinated attack — rare). "annul": the flag goes and Neblla reviews the case, states included (you saw a bug where the anticheat saw a cheat). Leaving a case alone keeps it as it is. One decision per case.
name: neblla_decide_fog_case
title: Decide fog case
